name: 真『グランスケル・アルビオン』

skillset.skill: 70s CT - 7000% Light DMG (Physical). For 15s, increase own Light DMG by 30%. Additionally if user is Human, for 15s, increase allies' Physical DMG by 40% (stackable).

passive.ability1: When equipped by Guild Master Rayas, increase own Arts by 2/s and reduce EX - Albion Blaze's cooldown by 30s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
